lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct vertical rows posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular spot nodes, forming a primary grid structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from a light dorsal edge to a dark ventral shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller teleost silhouettes (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface and trailing near the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
